name: COPRO-16
description: A CPU with a coprocessor. The accumulator CPU lives on the main bus with its memory and the LCD; a blitter sits between the main bus and its own video bus, where the screen is. The CPU hands the blitter a rectangle and a colour and says GO, and the blitter fills it by itself, one transfer per tick on the video bus, while the CPU carries on with its own program on the main bus.
tagline: A CPU that hands its drawing to a blitter

programs.name: Rectangles while the CPU writes
programs.description: The CPU prints each rectangle's name on the LCD while the blitter paints it

programs.name: Checkerboard
programs.description: The CPU plans the next square while the blitter fills the current one
